name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities: RFPs, Set-Asides, Deadlines
uses: Small businesses and 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB and WOSB firms watching set-asides in their NAICS codes
Bid and capture teams building a daily opportunity pipeline
GovCon consultants running alerts for many clients
AI agents answering which federal RFPs are open for a capability

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.title: Keywords
inputs.description: Optional free-text search over SAM.gov notice titles and text, e.g. "cybersecurity" or "janitorial services". Leave empty to return all notices that match the other filters.

inputs.name: naicsCodes
inputs.title: NAICS codes
inputs.description: Optional list of 6-digit NAICS industry codes (strings), e.g. ["541511","541512"]. A notice matches if it has any of them. Empty = all industries.

inputs.name: noticeTypes
inputs.title: Notice types
inputs.description: Optional list of notice type codes: o=Solicitation, k=Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, p=Presolicitation, r=Sources Sought, s=Special Notice, a=Award Notice, u=Justification, i=Intent to Bundle, g=Surplus sale. Empty = all types.

inputs.name: setAsides
inputs.title: Set-asides
inputs.description: Optional small-business set-aside codes, e.g. ["SBA","8A","SDVOSBC","WOSB","HZC"]. Empty = any set-aside or none.

inputs.name: states
inputs.title: Place of performance (state codes)
inputs.description: Optional 2-letter US state codes for the place of performance, e.g. ["VA","MD"]. Requires includeDetails=true. Empty = all locations.

inputs.name: agencyContains
inputs.title: Agency contains
inputs.description: Optional case-insensitive text the agency path must contain, e.g. "Navy" or "Veterans Affairs".

inputs.name: postedWithinDays
inputs.title: Posted/updated within (days)
inputs.description: Only notices posted or updated in the last N days. 0 = no date limit. Use 1-7 for daily/weekly monitoring.

inputs.name: minDaysUntilResponse
inputs.title: Minimum days until response deadline
inputs.description: Optional. Skip notices whose response deadline is fewer than N days away, so you only get ones you can still bid on.

inputs.name: includeDetails
inputs.title: Fetch full details
inputs.description: true (default) = fetch each notice for NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, full description and contacts. false = faster, fewer fields.

inputs.name: includeContacts
inputs.title: Include contracting officer contacts
inputs.description: true (default) = include the contracting officer work name, email and phone published on the notice.

inputs.name: onlyNew
inputs.title: Only new since last run (monitor mode)
inputs.description: true = return only notices not delivered in an earlier run with the same filters (state is kept between runs). Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.title: Max results
inputs.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). You are charged per row returned, so this caps the cost: 100 rows = $0.20 at $0.002/row.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.title: SAM.gov API key (optional)
inputs.description: Optional. Your own free api.sam.gov public API key; when set, the Actor reads the official SAM.gov Opportunities API instead of the public search feed.

description: Federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov with NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, response deadline and days left, contracting contacts, and a new-only monitoring mode. No API key needed.

inputSchema.description: Returns U.S. federal contract opportunities (RFPs, RFQs, sources sought, award notices) from SAM.gov as one JSON row per notice. All inputs are optional; a good default is {"keywords":"software","postedWithinDays":7,"maxResults":50}. Pricing: pay per event, $0.002 per opportunity row returned.
